title: Mahoowo Barkeeji
intro: E nder leyɗeele jaajɗe, neɗɗo baawɗo wonde fof, ummii e njilluuji keewɗi, rokki ɗum laamu e kaɓirɗe keewɗe. Ndee ɗoo yonta hawri e renndooji ceertuɗi, hawri e caɗeele keewɗe, acci heen maande duumiinde e daartol e iimanaagal rewrude e golle mum en e hakkillaaji mum en, tawi fof e jaɓde ko woni goonga e doole mum en.
clues: Mi hokkaama baawɗe e doole dow kala huunde, mi rewi laawol.
Laawol am nawtii kam to mutal naange, taw-mi leñol.
Mi hawri e renndo ngo waawataa faamde haala, hoɗngo hakkunde koɗli ɗiɗi.
Mi naamnaama yo mi mah jolngo, wonaa ngam nafoore am, kono ngam reende e doole halkoore.
Mi hollitii wonde doole mahngo ndee ɗoo mahdi mawndi ummorii ko e Alla, nde darii haa waktu fodanooɗo.
Innde am, nde heewi firteede ko ‘Galɗo Ɗiɗi’, ina hollita yettaade am e nder leydi ndii walla ma a taw yontaaji ɗiɗi ceertuɗi.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
